id: title:Gilbert09:classify a concurrent reset losing a delta log commit file as transient

review.reason: Adds exception handling and classification for transient Delta Lake maintenance errors, including a regression test for concurrent maintenance race conditions and updated string checks for missing delta log files. This improves warehouse ingestion reliability by distinguishing transient failures from permanent ones, allowing recovery instead of treating them as permanent failures.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and recovery implementation are not fully demonstrated; the score relies on the presence of classification and test additions rather than verified recovery execution. No unverified outcomes or adoption metrics are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds import for deltalake.exceptions to support exception classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion relies on deltalake; this enables runtime checks for transient maintenance errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case expecting a transient DeltaError with a specific message and False transient classification, while adding a comment explaining the race condition.
